text: Bag, crossbody and pouch: here's what goes in each one.

The pouch takes the little things. The bag takes the rest. Thoughtful pockets give your phone, your wallet and your keys a spot of their own, so nothing gets lost at the bottom.

Soft bags usually hang open at the top. This one zips.
Here's a myth. A soft, slouchy bag has to hang open at the top, with everything inside on show for anyone walking behind you.
Not this one. It's soft and slouchy, and it has anti-theft zips. So your things stay closed up while you walk through the busy street.
Watch the zip. One pull, and it's shut. Your phone and your valuables are tucked into thoughtful pockets, out of sight, and you never had to hold the top closed.
And the soft part is real. It keeps that soft, slouchy silhouette, so it hangs relaxed on your shoulder as you move through your day.
The shape is relaxed and timeless too, so it goes with any outfit. Jeans on a Tuesday, something nicer on a Saturday, and the same bag works for both.
